audio.audio_note: Single calm female Korean voiceover; text_raw is uncorrected whisper, corrected against on-screen caption pills which mirror the VO. Likely soft BGM bed; whisper speech_coverage 0.906.

inferred_creative_thinking.insight: People who are watching for the right moment to buy or sell an apartment get tired of manually re-searching the market price over and over, and they fear missing a price move while they are not looking
inferred_creative_thinking.persona: A Korean adult in their late 20s to 40s who has a specific apartment in mind (to buy, sell, or that they already own) and wants to track its real transaction-based price without doing repeated manual lookups
inferred_creative_thinking.moment: The recurring chore-and-anxiety of opening a property app to re-check a price you already looked up last week, never sure if a new deal just changed the market
inferred_creative_thinking.product_role: Toss turns its everyday finance super-app into a passive real-estate watchtower: register the apartment once, then it surfaces trend, 전세/월세 and nearby prices, and pushes an alert the instant a new transaction is recorded
inferred_creative_thinking.punchline: Register it once and let Toss tap you on the shoulder the moment the price actually moves, instead of you checking forever
inferred_creative_thinking.differentiator: The market-price tracking lives inside the same fintech super-app the user already opens daily, and the push notification on a real new transaction is the unique payoff that a static property-search app does not give
inferred_creative_thinking.brand_fit_one_liner: A fintech that keeps earning daily trust by quietly absorbing yet another tedious life-admin task — here, watching the housing market for you

inferred_brief: Create a ~41-second vertical hidden-service explainer showing how Toss lets users register an apartment and passively receive real-estate market-price trends and push alerts, opening with a relatable 'tired of re-searching prices' live-action hook, walking through the in-app steps via overhead screen recording with voiceover-synced caption pills, and paying off with a Toss push notification, closed by the 'Curator T — discover Toss' brand sticker.
analyst_notes: 11 shots from 12 scenedetect macro-scenes; the long phone screen-recording (11.38-26.09, scene 7) is one continuous locked overhead tabletop take treated as cut06, with the 26.09 전세/월세 content boundary opened as cut07. Two live-action bookends (presenter ECU hook cut01, presenter medium title-card cut04) and an outro paper title card (cut11 'Curator T / 토스를 발견하다'). Captions are word-by-word overlays in the live-action/early UI section and bottom-centered grey/black pill captions during the tabletop walkthrough; both mirror the single female VO. Service = Toss 부동산 시세 알림 (apartment market-price tracking + push alert). On-screen demo property anonymized as '행복마을 ...' 경기도 화성시 기산동, 전용 84.91㎡ (33평), 매매 시세 3억 8,000만원.
